{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Focus on completed orders only — refunded orders are not conversions
completed_only = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by customer_segment and compute conversion rate
# Conversion rate = (number of converted orders) / (total number of orders)
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Extract the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates_sorted[['conversion_rate']])

# Return the segment name
highest_segment"}
